name: coding
description: Heavy code editing tool: create/edit/refactor code files of any type (py, js, ts, tsx, jsx, php, md, java, go, rs, c, cpp, h, hpp, css, scss, less, html, vue, svelte, rb, swift, kt, dart, lua, r, scala, sh, yaml, yml, json, xml, sql, toml, ini, cfg, dockerfile, makefile, terraform, tf, hcl, etc.)

arguments.name: action
arguments.description: create, edit, refactor, format, lint, search_replace

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: File path relative to work dir

arguments.name: insert_after
arguments.description: Insert content after this text (for edit action)

arguments.name: insert_before
arguments.description: Insert content before this text (for edit action)

arguments.name: line_end
arguments.description: End line number for edit (1-indexed, inclusive)
